tirupati.name: Tirupati
tirupati.description: One of the most sacred pilgrimage centers in the world, home to the ancient hilltop shrine of Sri Venkateswara Swamy atop the Seven Hills of Tirumala.
tirupati.seasonal_climate: Tropical climate (22°C - 35°C). Best visited between September and March during pleasant winter conditions.

activities.name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Tirumala)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Tirumala Venkateswara Temple Ananda Nilayam
activities.description: World-famous ancient Dravidian Vaishnavite shrine situated on Venkatadri, crowned with a gilded golden Ananda Nilayam dome.
activities.reason: Holistic spiritual center of Tirupati and an unmatched Dravidian architectural marvel.

activities.name: Silathoranam Natural Geological Rock Arch
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Silathoranam Natural Arch Tirumala
activities.description: Rare pre-Cambrian geological natural stone arch formed millions of years ago in the picturesque Tirumala hills.
activities.reason: Spectacular natural wonder and designated National Geological Monument.

activities.name: Kapila Theertham Waterfalls & Shiva Temple
activities.description: Historic Shiva temple positioned at the base of a pristine mountain waterfall fed directly by mountain springs from the Tirumala range.
activities.reason: The only major Shaivite shrine in Tirupati, enveloped in fresh mountain breezes and cascading water.

activities.name: Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Sri Govindaraja Swamy Gopuram
activities.description: Grand 12th-century Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Lord Govindaraja, featuring an imposing 7-tier raja gopuram in downtown Tirupati.
activities.reason: Outstanding example of Vijayanagara and Chola temple architecture right in central Tirupati.

activities.name: Chandragiri Fort & Raja Mahal Palace
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Chandragiri Fort Raja Mahal
activities.description: 11th-century citadel of the Vijayanagara Empire with stone ramparts, an Indo-Sarcenic Raja Mahal palace, and an ASI archaeological museum.
activities.reason: Fascinating royal palace architecture with evening sound and light presentations.

activities.name: Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple (Tiruchanur)
activities.description: Sacred temple dedicated to Goddess Padmavathi (Alamelu Manga), consort of Lord Venkateswara, on the banks of the sacred Padma Sarovaram.
activities.reason: Crucial traditional pilgrimage stop customarily visited alongside Tirumala shrine.

activities.name: TTD Gardens & Swami Pushkarini Promenade
activities.description: Exquisite 460-acre landscaped gardens cultivating aromatic flowers and medicinal plants for the daily sacred seva of Lord Venkateswara.
activities.reason: Serene highland garden stroll with tranquil reflection by the holy water tank.

activities.name: Regional Science Centre & Planetarium
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Regional Science Centre Tirupati
activities.description: Engaging interactive science center featuring a digital planetarium dome, dinosaur park, and celestial observation equipment.
activities.reason: Educational and inspiring stop offering a relaxing indoor break during midday warmth.

activities.name: Sri Kalyana Venkateswara Swamy Temple
activities.description: Historic Vijayanagara-era temple where Lord Venkateswara is believed to have resided after wedding Goddess Padmavathi at Narayanavanam.
activities.reason: Architecturally rich temple boasting exquisite stone carvings and deep spiritual lore.

activities.name: Deer Park & Seshachalam Biosphere Overlook
activities.description: Forest reserve along the ghat road home to spotted deer herds, endemic flora, and viewpoints across the Tirumala hill range.
activities.reason: Peaceful wildlife spotting and panoramic hill photography stop.

visakhapatnam.name: Visakhapatnam
visakhapatnam.description: The 'Jewel of the East Coast', renowned for serene golden beaches, scenic Eastern Ghats hills, maritime museums, and vibrant coastal culture.
visakhapatnam.seasonal_climate: Tropical maritime climate (24°C - 33°C). Best visited between October and March.

activities.name: RK Beach & Coastal Marine Promenade
activities.description: Bustling coastal promenade along the Bay of Bengal lined with seaside parks, war memorials, and seaside food stalls.
activities.reason: The quintessential seaside gathering place of Vizag with sweeping ocean vistas.

activities.name: INS Kursura Submarine Museum
activities.opening_hours: 02:00 PM - 08:30 PM (Sundays open 10:00 AM - Closed Mondays)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / INS Kursura Submarine Museum
activities.description: Real decommissioned Soviet-built Kalvari-class submarine preserved on the sands of RK Beach, showcasing naval warfare history.
activities.reason: First submarine museum in South Asia; walkthrough inside actual control rooms and torpedo tubes.

activities.name: Kailasagiri Hilltop Park & Ropeway
activities.description: Scenic hilltop garden 360 feet above sea level with colossal white marble Shiva-Parvathi statues, scenic cable car ropeway, and panoramic Bay of Bengal views.
activities.reason: Finest panoramic view of Vizag city coastline and Eastern Ghats hills.

activities.name: Rushikonda Beach & Coastal Water Sports
activities.description: Pristine Blue Flag certified golden crescent beach with gentle waves, water surfing, kayaking, and coastal hill backdrops.
activities.reason: Top beach in Andhra Pradesh for swimming and thrilling water sports.

activities.name: TU 142M Aircraft Museum
activities.description: Authentic long-range maritime reconnaissance anti-submarine aircraft preserved as an interactive public aerospace exhibit.
activities.reason: Rare opportunity to step inside a legendary cold-war anti-submarine aircraft.

activities.name: Simhachalam Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple
activities.description: 11th-century hilltop temple dedicated to Lord Narasimha, featuring ornate Orissan and Chola architecture covered in sandalwood paste.
activities.reason: Majestic hilltop heritage temple offering sweeping views of Visakhapatnam valley.

activities.name: Dolphin's Nose & British Lighthouse
activities.description: Massive 358-meter rock promontory resembling a dolphin snout guarding the natural harbor, crowned by a historic operational lighthouse.
activities.reason: Unrivaled ocean vista taking in naval docks, Yarada beach, and the Bay of Bengal horizon.

activities.name: Tenneti Beach Park & Sea Viewpoint
activities.description: Picturesque coastal cliff park on the Beach Road overlooking turquoise waters and the stranded Bangladeshi cargo ship.
activities.reason: Breathtaking cliffside photography and sunset stroll on the coastal highway.

activities.name: Indira Gandhi Zoological Park
activities.description: Spread over 625 acres in the Kambalakonda reserve forest, home to over 80 wildlife species including leopards, tigers, and exotic aviaries.
activities.reason: Sprawling green coastal biosphere with battery-operated vehicles and lake paths.

activities.name: Ross Hill & St. Aloysius Church Promenade
activities.description: Historic hill overlooking the port entrance where a Catholic chapel, a Dargah, and a Hindu temple coexist harmoniously.
activities.reason: Symbol of communal harmony and vantage point to witness container ships gliding into port.

bhadrachalam.name: Bhadrachalam
bhadrachalam.description: Holy temple town on the banks of the sacred Godavari River, immortalized by the Ramayana epic and Saint Bhakta Ramadasu.
bhadrachalam.seasonal_climate: Tropical climate (20°C - 36°C). Best visited between October and March.

activities.name: Sri Sita Ramachandra Swamy Temple
activities.description: Historic 17th-century Vaishnavite temple built by saint-composer Bhakta Ramadasu, consecrated to Lord Rama in Vaikuntha posture.
activities.reason: The paramount spiritual attraction of Bhadrachalam overlooking the Godavari.

activities.name: Parnasala Heritage Ashram & Sacred Stream
activities.description: Mythological hermitage where Lord Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana spent years of forest exile according to regional lore.
activities.reason: Peaceful riverbank setting deeply connected to Ramayana folklore.

activities.name: Godavari River Ghats & Sunset Boat Cruise
activities.description: Sweeping stone bathing ghats along the mighty Godavari with evening river breeze and picturesque boat cruises.
activities.reason: Serene sunset views reflecting across one of peninsular India's widest river expanses.

activities.name: Abhaya Anjaneya Swamy Temple
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Anjaneya Swamy Shrine Bhadrachalam
activities.description: Colossal shrine dedicated to Lord Hanuman, featuring ornate carved mandapams and peaceful shaded gardens.
activities.reason: Key spiritual companion shrine to the main Bhadrachalam temple.

kochi.name: Kochi
kochi.description: The 'Queen of the Arabian Sea', boasting an extraordinary blend of Portuguese, Dutch, British, and ancient spice trading heritage.
kochi.seasonal_climate: Tropical coastal climate (23°C - 32°C). Best visited October to March.

activities.name: Chinese Fishing Nets & Fort Kochi Promenade
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Chinese Fishing Nets Kochi
activities.description: Cantilevered shore-operated fishing nets introduced by 14th-century Chinese traders, silhouetted against the Arabian Sea sunset.
activities.reason: Kochi's most iconic maritime sight and top photography destination.

activities.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
activities.description: Portuguese-built palace renovated by the Dutch, famed for exquisite Hindu murals depicting Ramayana and Mahabharata scenes.
activities.reason: Rare Renaissance-vernacular Kerala fusion palace housing ancient royal artifacts.

activities.name: Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Santa Cruz Basilica Kochi
activities.description: Historic gothic cathedral endowed by the Portuguese in 1505, known for delicate frescoed ceilings and pastel Gothic arches.
activities.reason: One of the eight basilicas in India and a masterpiece of Indo-European architecture.

activities.name: Paradesi Jewish Synagogue & Jew Town
activities.opening_hours: 10:00 AM - 05:00 PM (Closed Fridays, Saturdays & Jewish Holidays)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Paradesi Synagogue Jew Town
activities.description: Built in 1568, the oldest active synagogue in the Commonwealth, featuring hand-painted Chinese willow-pattern porcelain tiles and Belgian chandeliers.
activities.reason: Living chronicle of Malabar's centuries-old Jewish spice trade community.

activities.name: St. Francis Church Fort Kochi
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / St Francis Church Kochi
activities.description: Constructed in 1503, the oldest European-built church in India and the original burial site of explorer Vasco da Gama.
activities.reason: Key historical landmark marking the arrival of the colonial era in Asia.

activities.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
activities.description: Portuguese-built palace gifted to Raja of Kochi in 1555, housing vibrant Hindu murals depicting Ramayana and Mahabharata scenes.
activities.reason: National monument displaying remarkable medieval Kerala mural art and royal palanquins.

activities.name: Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue
activities.description: Atmospheric heritage quarter lined with antique curiosity shops, aromatic spice warehouses, and India's oldest active synagogue (1568).
activities.reason: Rich colonial trading history with Belgian glass chandeliers and Chinese hand-painted tiles.

activities.name: Marine Drive Promenade & Rainbow Bridge
activities.description: Scenic waterfront promenade in downtown Ernakulam facing Vembanad Lake and shipping channels with illuminated arched footbridges.
activities.reason: Breezy sunset harbor walk popular for watching ferryboats and Kochi skyline lights.

alappuzha.name: Alappuzha
alappuzha.description: The 'Venice of the East', famed for endless labyrinthine backwater canals, traditional kettuvallam houseboats, and serene coconut-fringed lagoons.
alappuzha.seasonal_climate: Humid coastal climate (22°C - 33°C). Peak houseboat season is October to March.

activities.name: Punnamada Backwater Houseboat Cruise
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Kerala Backwater Houseboat Alappuzha
activities.description: Gliding on a traditional thatched kettuvallam through Vembanad Lake, paddy wetlands, and water-lily laden canals.
activities.reason: The quintessential Kerala backwaters experience with fresh regional Karimeen dining.

activities.name: Alappuzha Beach & Historic Pier Lighthouse
activities.opening_hours: Lighthouse: 03:00 PM - 05:00 PM; Beach: Open 24 Hours
activities.description: Wide sand beach with a 150-year-old railway sea pier extending into the Arabian Sea and a striped operational lighthouse.
activities.reason: Prime evening sunset walk and panoramic marine views from the lighthouse balcony.

activities.name: Marari Beach & Coastal Village
activities.description: Pristine white sand coastal village beach shaded by swaying coconut groves, free from noisy commercial crowds.
activities.reason: Serene beach retreat and authentic Malabar coastal fisherman village experience.

activities.name: Krishnapuram Palace & Museum
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Krishnapuram Palace Mural Art
activities.description: 18th-century Travancore royal residence containing Kerala's largest single-panel mural painting: Gajendra Moksham.
activities.reason: Architectural marvel of Kerala gabled timber construction and ancient bronze relics.

activities.name: Alappuzha Lighthouse & Maritime Heritage Museum
activities.description: Built in 1862, this striking red-and-white striped tower houses an original teakwood spiral staircase and 360-degree coastal lookout.
activities.reason: Panoramic view of Alappuzha town, canal waterways, and sea pier from the gallery.

activities.name: Punnamada Lake & Nehru Trophy Race Course
activities.description: Historic watercourse where the world-renowned Nehru Trophy Snake Boat (Chundan Vallam) races take place each August.
activities.reason: Experience the heart of Kerala backwater boating culture and shikara cruising.

activities.name: Revi Karunakaran Memorial Museum
activities.description: Classical Greco-Roman style private museum housing rare Swarovski crystals, Tanjore paintings, and antique porcelain treasures.
activities.reason: Fascinating collection of global decorative arts in the Venice of the East.

activities.name: Krishnapuram Palace & Gajendra Moksham Mural
activities.description: 18th-century palace built by Travancore king Anizham Thirunal Marthanda Varma showcasing gabled roofs, dormer windows, and the largest single mural in Kerala.
activities.reason: Authentic Kerala wooden palace architecture and monumental 49-square-foot fresco.

puducherry.name: Puducherry
puducherry.description: The French Riviera of the East, celebrated for pastel colonial villas, bougainvillea lanes, peaceful seaside promenades, and the universal spiritual community of Auroville.
puducherry.seasonal_climate: Tropical coastal climate (22°C - 34°C). Best visited October to March.

activities.name: Promenade Beach & French War Memorial
activities.opening_hours: Promenade pedestrian-only from 05:00 PM to 06:30 AM
activities.description: 1.5-kilometer scenic rock beach promenade lined with heritage statues, seaside cafes, and French colonial edifices.
activities.reason: Vibrant pedestrian seawalk capturing the romantic essence of Pondicherry.

activities.name: French Quarter (White Town) Heritage Walk
activities.opening_hours: Best explored early morning or late afternoon
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / White Town French Quarter Pondicherry
activities.description: Grid-planned French quarter featuring mustard-yellow colonial mansions, arched courtyards, wrought-iron balconies, and artisan boutiques.
activities.reason: Unrivalled Franco-Tamil architectural heritage with bohemian cafes and bakery aromas.

activities.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
activities.description: Spiritual community founded in 1926 by Sri Aurobindo and Mirra Alfassa (The Mother), centered around the flower-bedecked marble Samadhi.
activities.reason: Deeply peaceful sanctuary of meditation and integral yoga in the heart of town.

activities.name: Auroville & Matrimandir Meditation Sphere
activities.description: Universal township dedicated to human unity, centered around the golden-domed geodesic Matrimandir surrounded by peaceful green amphitheaters.
activities.reason: Global architectural marvel and visionary international intentional township.

activities.name: Paradise Beach & Chunnambar Boat House
activities.description: Isolated golden sand beach accessible via a scenic backwater boat cruise along the Chunnambar River.
activities.reason: One of South India's cleanest and most secluded beaches with serene mangrove estuaries.

activities.name: Auroville Matrimandir & Peace Gardens
activities.description: Universal township founded by Mirra Alfassa (The Mother) centered around the golden geodesic dome of Matrimandir for silent concentration.
activities.reason: Unique global spiritual community showcasing sustainable architecture and deep peace.

activities.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
activities.description: Striking French Gothic basilica established in 1908, celebrated for its rare stained glass panels depicting 28 saints.
activities.reason: Exemplary French ecclesiastical architecture and tranquil spiritual refuge.

shirdi.name: Shirdi
shirdi.description: World-renowned holy pilgrimage town honoring revered 19th-century saint Sri Sai Baba, preaching harmony, unconditional love, and service.
shirdi.seasonal_climate: Semi-arid climate (18°C - 34°C). Pleasantly cool from October to March.

activities.name: Shri Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir Shirdi
activities.description: Sacred Italian marble shrine consecrated over the mortal remains of Sai Baba, adorned with gold spires and silver railings.
activities.reason: The paramount spiritual attraction of Shirdi visited by millions of pilgrims globally.

activities.name: Dwarkamai Masjid & Sacred Dhuni Fire
activities.description: Historic mosque where Sai Baba lived for over 60 years, maintaining an eternal sacred fire (Dhuni) whose holy ash (Udi) is distributed.
activities.reason: Deeply sacred heart of Sai Baba's humanitarian teachings and healing legacy.

activities.name: Chavadi Historic Meeting Shrine
activities.description: Historic building where Sai Baba slept on alternate nights during the last decade of his life, site of the Thursday Palkhi procession.
activities.reason: Authentic historical shrine preserving Sai Baba's original wooden bed and portrait.

activities.name: Khandoba Mandir & Neem Tree Gurusthan
activities.description: Ancient Shiva/Khandoba temple where priest Mahalsapati first greeted the young saint with the immortal greeting 'Aao Sai' (Welcome Sai).
activities.reason: The foundational site where the name 'Sai Baba' was first uttered.

nashik.name: Nashik
nashik.description: Ancient holy city on the banks of the Godavari River, renowned for the Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, the Kumbh Mela, and as the Wine Capital of India.
nashik.seasonal_climate: Tropical wet and dry climate (16°C - 32°C). Pleasant winters from October to March.

activities.name: Trimbakeshwar Shiva Jyotirlinga Temple
activities.description: One of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas, featuring a unique three-faced linga embodying Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva near the source of the Godavari.
activities.reason: Ancient black-basalt architectural marvel surrounded by the lush Brahmagiri mountains.

activities.name: Panchavati, Sita Gufaa & Ramkund
activities.description: Sacred Godavari riverbank ghats where the Kumbh Mela unfolds, five ancient banyan trees, and the cave where Sita took refuge.
activities.reason: Spiritual epicenter of Nashik steeped in Ramayana lore.

activities.name: Sula Vineyards Winery Tour & Tasting
activities.description: Pioneering Indian winery estate set against Gangapur lake hills, offering guided oak-barrel cellar tours and grape-crushing tastings.
activities.reason: India's premier wine-tourism estate with Tuscan-style vineyard terraces.

activities.name: Kalaram Temple
activities.description: Magnificent 1782 black stone temple built by Sardar Rangarao Odhekar, housing a rare black sand deity of Lord Rama.
activities.reason: Outstanding Peshwa architecture with historic significance in modern social reform movements.

guntur.name: Guntur
guntur.description: Historic cultural and agrarian hub of coastal Andhra, celebrated for ancient Buddhist heritage at Amaravati, hilltop fortresses, and vibrant culinary traditions.
guntur.seasonal_climate: Tropical climate (22°C - 36°C). Best visited between October and February.

activities.name: Amaravati Buddhist Mahastupa & Archaeological Museum
activities.description: 2,000-year-old ancient Buddhist Great Stupa (Deepaladinne) constructed during Satavahana rule, showcasing magnificent limestone carvings of Jataka tales.
activities.reason: One of India's greatest Buddhist heritage centers and source of the renowned Amaravati art school.

activities.name: Dhyana Buddha Colossal Statue
activities.description: Colossal 125-foot seated Buddha statue in meditative posture overlooking the Krishna River, complete with museum galleries in its pedestal.
activities.reason: Towering modern Buddhist landmark symbolizing peace along the holy river Krishna.

activities.name: Undavalli Rock-Cut Caves
activities.description: 4-story solid sandstone monolithic rock-cut cave temple from the 7th-century Vishnukundina dynasty, featuring a colossal reclining Vishnu.
activities.reason: Exemplary rock-cut monolithic craftsmanship with panoramic Krishna delta countryside views.

activities.name: Kondaveedu Fort & Hilltop Viewpoint
activities.description: 14th-century Reddy dynasty hilltop citadel with stone battlements, reservoirs, granaries, and trekking trails 1,700 feet above sea level.
activities.reason: Thrilling hilltop fort ruins offering sweeping vistas across the Andhra plains.

vijayawada.name: Vijayawada
vijayawada.description: The 'Place of Victory' on the banks of the sacred Krishna River, framed by the Indrakeeladri Hills, ancient rock caves, and river islands.
vijayawada.seasonal_climate: Tropical climate (22°C - 35°C). Best visited between October and March.

activities.name: Kanaka Durga Temple (Indrakeeladri Hill)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Kanaka Durga Temple Vijayawada
activities.description: Legendary hillside temple perched on Indrakeeladri peak overlooking the Krishna River, dedicated to Goddess Durga in Swayambhu form.
activities.reason: The paramount spiritual attraction of Vijayawada and prime vantage overlooking the city.

activities.name: Prakasam Barrage & Krishna River Walkway
activities.description: 1,223-meter engineering marvel spanning across the Krishna River, creating a vast lake reservoir with scenic nighttime illuminations.
activities.reason: Iconic riverfront landmark linking Krishna and Guntur districts with refreshing river breezes.

activities.name: Undavalli Monolithic Rock Caves
activities.description: Ancient multi-tiered rock-hewn sanctuary from the 7th century carved with elaborate pillared halls and massive sandstone sculptures.
activities.reason: Architectural masterpiece bridging Buddhist and early Hindu cave temple craftsmanship.

activities.name: Bhavani Island & River Adventure Park
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Bhavani Island Krishna River
activities.description: 133-acre verdant river island nestled amidst the Krishna River, accessible via motorboat with water sports and tree-top cottages.
activities.reason: One of India's largest river islands offering family adventure and peaceful nature walks.

jammu_and_kashmir.name: Jammu and Kashmir
jammu_and_kashmir.description: Paradise on Earth, framed by snow-crowned Himalayan peaks, shimmering Dal Lake shikaras, royal Mughal terraced gardens, and the alpine meadows of Gulmarg and Pahalgam.
jammu_and_kashmir.seasonal_climate: Alpine climate (0°C - 24°C). Spring/Summer (April - September) for gardens; Winter (December - March) for snow sports in Gulmarg.

activities.name: Dal Lake & Shikara Wooden Houseboat Ride
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Dal Lake Srinagar Shikaras
activities.description: Gliding on a hand-carved cedar shikara across lotus-strewn Dal Lake, floating vegetable markets, and cedar wood houseboats beneath Zabarwan peaks.
activities.reason: The quintessential Kashmir experience and an unforgettable sunset photography vista.

activities.name: Mughal Terraced Gardens (Shalimar & Nishat Bagh)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Nishat Bagh Mughal Garden
activities.description: 17th-century Persian-style terraced garden built by Emperor Jahangir and Asif Khan, boasting tiered waterfalls, ancient chinar trees, and flower beds.
activities.reason: UNESCO-recognized pinnacle of Mughal royal garden landscaping overlooking Dal Lake.

activities.name: Gulmarg Gondola & Apharwat Snow Peak
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Gulmarg Gondola Cable Car
activities.description: One of the world's highest cable cars, carrying travelers to 13,780 feet onto Mount Apharwat for snow skiing and alpine panoramas.
activities.reason: Unrivalled Himalayan high-altitude cable car journey with breathtaking glacial views.

activities.name: Pahalgam & Betaab Valley River Meadows
activities.description: Pristine mountain valley along the crystalline Lidder River, enveloped by dense pine and deodar forests and snow-covered peaks.
activities.reason: World-famous valley setting renowned for trout angling, horse trails, and cinematic beauty.

mysuru.name: Mysuru
mysuru.description: The Heritage City of Karnataka, renowned for the opulent Indo-Saracenic Mysore Palace, aromatic sandalwood, Mysore pak, and Chamundi Hill.
mysuru.seasonal_climate: Tropical savanna climate (18°C - 31°C). Best visited between September and March, especially during grand Dasara festivities.

activities.name: Mysore Palace (Amba Vilas)
activities.opening_hours: 10:00 AM - 05:30 PM (Illuminated Sundays and Holidays 07:00 PM - 07:45 PM)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Mysore Palace Illuminated Amba Vilas
activities.description: Grand Indo-Saracenic royal residence of the Wadiyar dynasty featuring stained glass ceilings, carved mahogany pavilions, and 97,000 electric bulbs.
activities.reason: One of India's most visited royal monuments and an absolute architectural masterpiece.

activities.name: Chamundi Hill & Sri Chamundeshwari Temple
activities.description: Hilltop shrine consecrated to Goddess Chamundeshwari with a 1,000-step stone path and a colossal 16-foot monolithic Nandi bull carved in 1659.
activities.reason: Sacred hilltop protector shrine offering panoramic views across the Mysore cityscape.

activities.name: Brindavan Gardens & Musical Dancing Fountains
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Brindavan Gardens KRS Dam
activities.description: 60-acre terraced garden laid out below the Krishnarajasagara Dam, modeled after the Shalimar Gardens with synchronized musical fountains.
activities.reason: Iconic evening illuminated garden show famous across South India.

activities.name: St. Philomena's Neo-Gothic Cathedral
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / St Philomena's Cathedral Mysore
activities.description: Towering 175-foot twin-spired Neo-Gothic cathedral modeled after Germany's Cologne Cathedral, containing beautiful stained-glass windows.
activities.reason: One of the tallest churches in Asia and an astonishing architectural landmark.

activities.name: Chamundi Hill & Sri Chamundeshwari Temple
activities.description: Hilltop temple dedicated to the patron goddess of Mysore, featuring a seven-tier gopuram and the famous monolithic 16-foot Nandi Bull.
activities.reason: Panoramic vista over Mysore city and royal palace from the mountain peak.

activities.name: Brindavan Gardens & Musical Fountains
activities.description: Terraced botanical gardens built adjoining the Krishnarajasagara Dam across Kaveri River, famous for evening laser and musical fountain shows.
activities.reason: Spectacular evening illuminated water gardens and blooming floral terraces.

activities.name: St. Philomena's Cathedral
activities.description: One of the tallest churches in Asia, built in 1936 with Neo-Gothic twin spires rising 175 feet inspired by Cologne Cathedral in Germany.
activities.reason: Awe-inspiring stained glass windows and catacombs beneath the high altar.

activities.name: Jaganmohan Palace & Art Gallery
activities.description: 1861 royal wooden palace now housing the Jayachamarajendra Art Gallery with original oil masterpieces by Raja Ravi Varma.
activities.reason: Priceless collection of royal portraits, musical instruments, and famous Glow of Hope painting.

kadapa.name: Kadapa
kadapa.description: Gateway to the sacred Tirumala hills and home to Gandikota — the 'Grand Canyon of India' — ancient Vijayanagara forts, and legendary Sufi dargahs.
kadapa.seasonal_climate: Semi-arid climate (20°C - 35°C). Best visited between October and February.

activities.name: Gandikota Fort & Grand Canyon of India
activities.description: Majestic 300-foot red granite gorge carved through the Erramala hills by the Penna River, alongside 13th-century fort ramparts, Raghunatha temple, and Jamia Masjid.
activities.reason: Spectacular natural canyon geological formation widely hailed as the Grand Canyon of India.

activities.name: Devuni Kadapa Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple
activities.description: Ancient Vijayanagara temple traditionally revered as the threshold threshold (Gadapa) where pilgrims must pray before journeying to Tirumala.
activities.reason: Foundational pilgrimage shrine giving Kadapa its historic name.

activities.name: Vontimitta Sri Kodandarama Swamy Temple
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Vontimitta Kodandarama Swamy Temple
activities.description: 16th-century Vijayanagara national heritage monument featuring intricate stone carvings, towering gopuram, and a 32-pillared Rangamantapa.
activities.reason: Exquisite architectural temple praised by Italian traveler Niccolao Manucci.

activities.name: Ameen Peer Dargah (Asthana-e-Maghdoom Ilahi)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Ameen Peer Dargah Kadapa
activities.description: Historic 17th-century Sufi shrine established by Sufi saint Pirullah Malik, visited by millions across all faiths.
activities.reason: Renowned beacon of communal harmony and spiritual peace in Rayalaseema.

kurnool.name: Kurnool
kurnool.description: Historical Gateway of Rayalaseema and first capital of Andhra State, famous for the subterranean Belum Caves, Konda Reddy Buruju, and unique rock gardens.
kurnool.seasonal_climate: Tropical semi-arid climate (20°C - 35°C). Best visited October to February.

activities.name: Belum Caves Subterranean Formations
activities.description: Second largest cave network in the Indian subcontinent, descending 150 feet underground with natural stalactite and stalagmite limestone galleries.
activities.reason: Sublime underground natural wonder with ancient Buddhist meditation relics.

activities.name: Konda Reddy Buruju (Kurnool Fort)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Konda Reddy Fort Kurnool
activities.description: Historic 12th-century circular stone bastion erected by the Vijayanagara kings, famous for an underground tunnel and heroic resistance history.
activities.reason: The defining architectural symbol of Kurnool city with sweeping urban views.

activities.name: Oravakallu Rock Garden & Silica Canyon
activities.description: Natural geological park of igneous quartz and silica rock formations carved into bizarre natural shapes surrounded by a scenic lake reservoir.
activities.reason: Surreal moonscape-like natural rock formations ideal for photography and trekking.

activities.name: Yaganti Uma Maheshwara Temple & Growing Nandi
activities.description: 15th-century Vijayanagara cave temple known for a natural water Pushkarini spring and a monolithic stone Nandi idol certified by ASI as naturally expanding.
activities.reason: Fascinating geological and spiritual marvel in the scenic Yerramala hills.

chennai.name: Chennai
chennai.description: Gateway to South India, renowned for the world's second-longest urban beach, ancient Dravidian gopurams, classical Carnatic music, and colonial Fort St. George.
chennai.seasonal_climate: Tropical maritime climate (24°C - 34°C). Pleasantly breezy from November to February.

activities.name: Marina Beach & Coastal Promenade
activities.opening_hours: Open 24 hours (Best early morning or evening)
activities.description: 13-kilometer natural urban sandy beach along the Bay of Bengal featuring historical statues, lighthouse vantage, and evening food markets.
activities.reason: The premier social and cultural lifeline of Chennai.

activities.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple (Mylapore)
activities.opening_hours: 06:00 AM - 01:00 PM, 04:00 PM - 09:00 PM (Closed Mondays noon)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Kapaleeshwarar Temple Gopuram Mylapore
activities.description: 7th-century Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring an intricately sculpted 120-foot multicolored raja gopuram and sacred temple tank.
activities.reason: Quintessential Dravidian architectural splendor in historic Mylapore.

activities.name: Fort St. George & Clive Museum
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Fort St George Chennai
activities.description: First British fortress in India built in 1644 by the East India Company, housing St. Mary's Church and a museum of colonial weaponry and portraits.
activities.reason: The foundational monument from which modern Chennai expanded.

activities.name: San Thome Cathedral Basilica
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / San Thome Basilica Chennai
activities.description: Neo-Gothic Roman Catholic cathedral built over the tomb of St. Thomas the Apostle, one of only three churches in the world built over an apostle's grave.
activities.reason: Rare global apostolic pilgrimage site with striking white spires.

puri.name: Puri
puri.description: Sacred Char Dham coastal city of Odisha, venerated for the towering Sri Jagannath Temple, the annual Ratha Yatra, and Blue Flag certified golden beaches.
puri.seasonal_climate: Tropical maritime climate (22°C - 33°C). Best visited between October and March.

activities.name: Sri Jagannath Temple & Anandabazar
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Sri Jagannath Temple Puri
activities.description: 12th-century Kalinga-style monumental temple standing 214 feet high, home to Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra, and the world's largest open food market.
activities.reason: One of India's four most sacred Char Dham pilgrimage shrines.

activities.name: Puri Golden Beach (Blue Flag Certified)
activities.description: Immaculately maintained Blue Flag certified golden sand beach offering safe swimming zones, jogging tracks, and evening sea breezes.
activities.reason: Internationally certified pristine beach for sunset strolls along the Bay of Bengal.

activities.name: Konark Sun Temple (Heritage Day Excursion, 35 km from Puri)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Konark Sun Temple Chariot Wheel
activities.description: 13th-century UNESCO World Heritage monumental chariot temple dedicated to Surya, located 35 km north-east of Puri along Marine Drive.
activities.reason: Breathtaking stone chariot with 24 carved sundial wheels; distinguished as an easy half-day coastal drive from Puri.

activities.name: Chilika Lake & Satapada Dolphin Sanctuary
activities.description: Asia's largest brackish water lagoon, where boats navigate to spot rare endangered Irrawaddy dolphins and Rajhans Island.
activities.reason: Exhilarating aquatic wildlife boat excursion from Satapada gateway.

kedarnath.name: Kedarnath
kedarnath.description: Supreme Himalayan Jyotirlinga shrine set at 11,755 feet against the towering snow-clad Kedarnath and Kedar Dome peaks near the source of the Mandakini River.
kedarnath.seasonal_climate: Alpine Himalayan climate (-10°C to 15°C). Open seasonally from May to October/November; strictly closed during winter months due to extreme snowfall.
kedarnath.seasonal_advisory: SEASONAL PILGRIMAGE TIMINGS: Kedarnath Temple operates seasonally from May to October (opens on Akshaya Tritiya in late April/early May and closes on Bhai Dooj in late October/early November). Strictly closed during winter months. Advance biometric registration and physical fitness preparation are required.

activities.name: Kedarnath Shiva Jyotirlinga Temple
activities.opening_hours: 05:00 AM - 01:30 PM, 05:00 PM - 09:00 PM (May - Nov season only)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Kedarnath Temple Garhwal Himalayas
activities.description: Ancient 8th-century stone temple built of massive grey granite slabs by Adi Shankaracharya, standing resolute against glaciers at 3,583 meters.
activities.reason: The highest of the 12 Jyotirlingas and one of the holiest shrines in Hinduism.

activities.name: Bhairavnath Guardian Temple & Ridge View
activities.description: Hilltop shrine dedicated to Bhairava, the guardian deity who protects the Kedarnath valley during winter months when the main temple is closed.
activities.reason: Spectacular aerial panorama overlooking Kedarnath valley and the Mandakini gorge.

activities.name: Vasuki Tal Glacial Alpine Lake Trek
activities.opening_hours: Daylight hours only (Experienced trek with local guide)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Vasuki Tal Alpine Glacial Lake
activities.description: Crystal-clear high altitude glacial lake situated at 14,200 feet, surrounded by the Chaukhamba peaks and Brahma Kamal alpine flowers.
activities.reason: Challenging Himalayan alpine trek rewarding hikers with pristine high-altitude vistas.

activities.name: Gandhi Sarovar (Chorabari Tal) Glacier Walk
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Chorabari Glacier Gandhi Sarovar
activities.description: Glacial lake at the foot of the Kedar Dome and Chorabari Glacier where Mahatma Gandhi's ashes were immersed in 1948.
activities.reason: Awe-inspiring view of icefalls and sheer vertical Himalayan rock walls.

badrinath.name: Badrinath
badrinath.description: Holy Char Dham mountain shrine dedicated to Lord Vishnu, nestled in the Garhwal Himalayas along the Alaknanda River between Nar and Narayana mountain ranges.
badrinath.seasonal_climate: Alpine mountain climate (5°C - 18°C in season). Temple doors open in May and close in November following Diwali.
badrinath.seasonal_advisory: SEASONAL PILGRIMAGE TIMINGS: Badrinath Temple operates seasonally from May to November. Strictly closed during winter months. Advance mandatory registration via Uttarakhand Char Dham Devasthanam Board is required.

activities.name: Badrinath Char Dham Temple
activities.opening_hours: 04:30 AM - 01:00 PM, 04:00 PM - 09:00 PM (May - Nov season only)
activities.description: Vibrant 50-foot tall painted stone temple with a conical roof and gilded cupola, enshrining a 1-meter high black Shaligram stone deity of Lord Badrinarayan.
activities.reason: One of the most sacred pilgrimage shrines in Hinduism and the crown jewel of the Char Dham circuit.

activities.name: Mana Village (Last Indian Border Village)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Mana Village Indo-Tibetan Border
activities.description: Designated 'First Village of India' located 3 km from Badrinath near the Indo-Tibetan border, home to Bhotia indigenous communities, Vyas Gufa, and Ganesh Gufa.
activities.reason: Fascinating high-altitude border village where Sage Vyasa composed the Mahabharata.

activities.name: Tapt Kund Natural Thermal Spring
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Tapt Kund Hot Spring
activities.description: Natural sulfur hot water spring on the Alaknanda riverbank maintaining a constant 55°C temperature despite surrounding freezing mountain weather.
activities.reason: Therapeutic medicinal thermal pool where pilgrims traditionally bathe before darshan.

activities.name: Vasudhara Falls & Alaknanda Glacial Trek
activities.description: Dramatic 400-foot waterfall cascading from glacial cliffs into the Alaknanda gorge, accessible via a 5 km mountain trail beyond Mana village.
activities.reason: Spectacular glacial waterfall setting amidst pristine Himalayan heights.

london.name: London
london.description: Global capital of culture, history, and commerce, featuring centuries of royal palaces, the River Thames, iconic red buses, and world-class free national museums.
london.seasonal_climate: Temperate maritime climate (6°C - 23°C). Summer (June - August) brings long daylight and festivals; Autumn offers crisp park foliage.

activities.name: Big Ben & Palace of Westminster
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Diliff (Clock Tower Palace of Westminster)
activities.description: The world's most famous gothic clock tower and the seat of the British Parliament on the north bank of the River Thames.
activities.reason: Iconic world landmark defining the historic London skyline.

activities.name: Tower Bridge & Glass Walkways
activities.description: Victorian neo-Gothic suspension bridge with twin towers, hydraulic engine rooms, and high-level glass floor walkways over the River Thames.
activities.reason: Spectacular river panoramas and a triumphant feat of Victorian civil engineering.

activities.name: Buckingham Palace & Changing of the Guard
activities.opening_hours: Guard change 11:00 AM (Select days); State Rooms open Summer
activities.description: The administrative headquarters of the British monarch, famous for royal pageantry, the Victoria Memorial, and Mall promenade.
activities.reason: Centerpiece of British royal heritage and ceremonial traditions.

activities.name: The British Museum
activities.description: World-famous museum dedicated to human history and art, housing the Rosetta Stone, Parthenon Sculptures, and Norman Foster Great Court.
activities.reason: Eight million works chronicling the history of world civilization, completely free of admission charge.

activities.name: London Eye River Thames Observation Wheel
activities.description: Europe's tallest cantilevered observation wheel standing 135 meters on the South Bank, offering 360-degree views across 40 kilometers of London.
activities.reason: Unrivalled sunset panoramic views over London's iconic river landmarks.

activities.name: Tower of London & Crown Jewels
activities.description: Nearly 1,000-year-old royal fortress and UNESCO World Heritage site guarding the Crown Jewels and Yeoman Warders (Beefeaters).
activities.reason: Iconic royal history fortress spanning Norman conquerors to medieval monarchs.

activities.name: Westminster Abbey
activities.description: Coronation site of British monarchs since 1066, famous Gothic abbey containing Poets' Corner and royal tombs.
activities.reason: Magnificent Gothic architecture steeped in British royal and literary history.

activities.name: St. Paul's Cathedral & Whispering Gallery
activities.description: Sir Christopher Wren's masterpiece featuring its world-renowned dome, crypt, and 360-degree panoramic Golden Gallery.
activities.reason: Climb the dome for one of the greatest views over the London skyline and river.

activities.name: Hyde Park & Kensington Gardens
activities.description: London's premier 350-acre Royal Park featuring the Serpentine boating lake, Diana Memorial Fountain, and Kensington Palace grounds.
activities.reason: Peaceful green oasis perfect for an afternoon stroll, boat pedal, or cafe break.

activities.name: Covent Garden & West End Theatre District
activities.description: Vibrant 19th-century Piazza lined with world-class street performers, craft stalls, luxury boutiques, and pre-theatre dining.
activities.reason: Lively evening cultural hub connecting Covent Garden Piazza and the West End theatre scene.

new_york.name: New York
new_york.description: The 'Big Apple' and capital of the world, featuring iconic Manhattan skyscrapers, Central Park greenery, Broadway theaters, and vibrant five-borough neighborhoods.
new_york.seasonal_climate: Humid continental climate (-2°C to 30°C). Spring (April-June) and Autumn (September-November) offer ideal walking weather.

activities.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Statue of Liberty Ellis Island
activities.description: Colossal neoclassical copper sculpture on Liberty Island gifted by France in 1886, universal symbol of freedom alongside the Ellis Island Immigration Museum.
activities.reason: Global monument to hope and freedom with breathtaking New York Harbor views.

activities.name: Central Park & Bethesda Terrace
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Central Park Mall New York
activities.description: 843-acre masterpiece of landscape architecture in the heart of Manhattan featuring Bow Bridge, Bethesda Fountain, the Mall, and Strawberry Fields.
activities.reason: The green lung of NYC offering tranquility amidst the soaring skyscraper canyons.

activities.name: Empire State Building 86th Floor Observatory
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Empire State Building Manhattan
activities.description: 102-story Art Deco skyscraper in Midtown Manhattan, offering open-air 360-degree vistas across six states from its 86th-floor observation deck.
activities.reason: The world's most famous Art Deco architectural icon and premier sunset vantage.

activities.name: Times Square & Broadway Theatre District
activities.description: The 'Crossroads of the World', illuminated by monumental electronic billboards, Broadway theater marquees, and dynamic street performance.
activities.reason: Electrifying spectacle of modern urban energy and entertainment.

activities.name: Brooklyn Bridge & DUMBO Promenade
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Brooklyn Bridge New York
activities.description: 1883 limestone neo-Gothic suspension bridge spanning the East River with elevated wooden pedestrian walkways connecting Manhattan and Brooklyn.
activities.reason: Iconic walk with dramatic Lower Manhattan skyline and water reflections.

activities.name: Brooklyn Bridge Pedestrian Promenade
activities.description: Iconic 1883 neo-Gothic suspension bridge connecting Manhattan and Brooklyn with sweeping East River and skyline vistas.
activities.reason: Essential New York walk offering historic cable architecture and skyline backdrops.

activities.name: The High Line & Hudson Yards Vessel
activities.description: Elevated 1.45-mile green parkway created on a historic freight rail line above the streets of Manhattan's West Side.
activities.reason: Urban design triumph featuring perennial gardens, public art installations, and Hudson River views.

activities.name: 9/11 Memorial & One World Observatory
activities.description: Reflecting memorial pools set in the original Twin Towers footprints and the Western Hemisphere's tallest spire observation deck.
activities.reason: Poignant national landmark and 102nd-floor 360-degree panorama of New York Harbor.

activities.name: Grand Central Terminal & Whispering Gallery
activities.description: World-famous Beaux-Arts transit cathedral featuring celestial vaulted ceiling, four-faced brass clock, and Vanderbilt heritage.
activities.reason: Architectural marvel and lively dining concourse in the heart of Midtown Manhattan.

activities.name: Rockefeller Center & Top of the Rock
activities.description: Historic Art Deco complex featuring Channel Gardens, Radio City Music Hall, and the unobstructed Empire State observation deck.
activities.reason: Best nighttime viewpoint in Manhattan showing the glowing Empire State Building and Central Park.

san_francisco.name: San Francisco
san_francisco.description: The City by the Bay, renowned for the orange towers of the Golden Gate Bridge, historic cable cars, Victorian Painted Ladies, and cool Pacific fogs.
san_francisco.seasonal_climate: Mediterranean maritime climate (10°C - 20°C). September and October are the warmest, sunniest months with minimal coastal fog.

activities.name: Golden Gate Bridge & Vista Point
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Golden Gate Bridge Rich Niewiroski Jr.
activities.description: 1.7-mile international orange suspension bridge linking San Francisco to Marin Headlands across the Golden Gate strait.
activities.reason: One of the modern wonders of the world and the definitive visual icon of California.

activities.name: Alcatraz Island & Historic Federal Penitentiary
activities.opening_hours: Ferry departures from Pier 33 08:40 AM - 04:00 PM
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Alcatraz Island D Ramey Logan
activities.description: Legendary offshore federal prison island in San Francisco Bay that once held Al Capone and Machine Gun Kelly, now a national park sanctuary.
activities.reason: Award-winning audio walkthrough of the historic cellhouse with panoramic bay skyline views.

activities.name: Fisherman's Wharf & Pier 39 Sea Lions
activities.description: Historic waterfront district famous for barking California sea lions basking on wooden marina docks, sourdough bread bowls, and Dungeness crab.
activities.reason: Lively maritime promenade with close-up marine wildlife observation.

activities.name: Twin Peaks 360-Degree Panoramic Overlook
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Twin Peaks San Francisco
activities.description: Two prominent coastal hills standing nearly 1,000 feet above the city, offering unobstructed 360-degree vistas across Market Street, the Bay Bridge, and downtown.
activities.reason: Top vantage point in San Francisco for sunset and nighttime skyline photography.

los_angeles.name: Los Angeles
los_angeles.description: Global entertainment capital of cinema, television, sun-drenched Pacific coastlines, artistic museums, and glamorous Hollywood hills.
los_angeles.seasonal_climate: Mediterranean climate (12°C - 28°C) with over 280 days of annual sunshine.

activities.name: Hollywood Sign & Griffith Park Trails
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Hollywood Sign Thomas Wolf
activities.description: Legendary 45-foot white lettering erected in 1923 atop Mount Lee in the Santa Monica Mountains overlooking the Los Angeles basin.
activities.reason: The universal cultural symbol of world cinema and Southern California glamour.

activities.name: Santa Monica Pier & Pacific Coast Promenade
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Santa Monica Pier Sunset
activities.description: Century-old wooden pleasure pier marking the official end of historic Route 66, featuring the Pacific Wheel solar ferris wheel and golden sand beaches.
activities.reason: Iconic Southern California coastal sunset experience with Pacific ocean boardwalk vibes.

activities.name: The Getty Center & Modern Hilltop Gardens
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Getty Center Los Angeles
activities.description: Richard Meier-designed travertine marble museum complex perched in the Brentwood hills, housing European master paintings, Van Gogh's Irises, and living gardens.
activities.reason: World-class cultural arts institution completely free of admission with tram ride access.

activities.name: Griffith Observatory & Samuel Oschin Planetarium
activities.opening_hours: 12:00 PM - 10:00 PM (Weekends open 10:00 AM - Closed Mondays)
activities.description: 1935 Art Deco public observatory on Mount Hollywood providing public telescope star viewing and sweeping panoramas of the illuminated LA metropolis.
activities.reason: Magical nighttime vantage over the entire illuminated city of Los Angeles.

yosemite.name: Yosemite
yosemite.description: America's premier national park sanctuary, famous for soaring granite monoliths El Capitan and Half Dome, thundering glacial waterfalls, and ancient giant sequoia groves.
yosemite.seasonal_climate: Alpine mountain climate (-4°C to 28°C). Late spring (May - June) brings peak waterfall torrents; Autumn offers golden foliage.

activities.name: Yosemite Valley & El Capitan Meadow
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / El Capitan Yosemite Valley
activities.description: Sheer 3,000-foot vertical granite monolith rising directly from the Merced River floor, world-renowned as the ultimate rock-climbing wall.
activities.reason: Jaw-dropping geological wonder dominating the Yosemite Valley.

activities.name: Half Dome & Glacier Point Overlook
activities.opening_hours: Glacier Point road open seasonally May to November
activities.description: Glacier Point perches 3,214 feet above Yosemite Valley, commanding an unforgettable amphitheater view of Half Dome and the high Sierra peaks.
activities.reason: The single most spectacular alpine viewpoint in the entire national park system.

activities.name: Yosemite Falls Trail & Lower Falls Loop
activities.description: North America's tallest waterfall dropping 2,425 feet in three dramatic tiers into mist-shrouded boulder fields.
activities.reason: Thunderous glacial torrent with accessible paved trail loops.

activities.name: Mariposa Grove of Giant Sequoias
activities.opening_hours: Open year-round (Shuttle runs spring through autumn)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Grizzly Giant Mariposa Grove
activities.description: Cathedral-like grove of over 500 mature giant sequoias, including the 3,000-year-old Grizzly Giant and the California Tunnel Tree.
activities.reason: Walking among the largest and oldest living organisms on Earth.

hong_kong.name: Hong Kong
hong_kong.description: Asia's World City, where futuristic neon high-rises overlook Victoria Harbour, historic green Star Ferries cross misty waters, and mountain trails lead to colossal bronze Buddhas.
hong_kong.seasonal_climate: Subtropical climate (15°C - 31°C). Autumn (October - December) is sunny, cool, and comfortable.

activities.name: Victoria Peak & The Peak Tram
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Victoria Peak Hong Kong
activities.description: Historic funicular tram climbing to 1,811 feet onto Victoria Peak for the quintessential view of Hong Kong Island skyscrapers and Kowloon harbor.
activities.reason: The #1 tourist destination in Hong Kong offering panoramic twilight views.

activities.name: Tian Tan Buddha (Big Buddha) & Po Lin Monastery
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Tian Tan Buddha Lantau Island
activities.description: Colossal 34-meter bronze Shakyamuni Buddha seated atop 268 stone steps on Lantau Island alongside the incense-laden Po Lin Zen Monastery.
activities.reason: Monumental spiritual sanctuary symbolizing harmony between man and nature.

activities.name: Avenue of Stars & Symphony of Lights
activities.opening_hours: Open 24 hours (Symphony of Lights at 08:00 PM daily)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Avenue of Stars Tsim Sha Tsui
activities.description: Tsim Sha Tsui harbor promenade celebrating Hong Kong cinema with handprints, Bruce Lee bronze sculpture, and the nightly laser skyline show.
activities.reason: Front-row waterfront vantage for the illuminated Victoria Harbour skyline.

activities.name: Historic Star Ferry Harbour Crossing
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Star Ferry Victoria Harbour
activities.description: Double-ended heritage green-and-white ferry crossing Victoria Harbour between Kowloon and Central since 1888 for just a few Hong Kong dollars.
activities.reason: Ranked by National Geographic as one of the 50 greatest travel experiences of a lifetime.

china.name: China
china.description: Ancient civilization of imperial dynasties and ultra-modern marvels, featuring the Great Wall, Beijing's Forbidden City, Hangzhou's West Lake, and Shanghai's waterfront Bund.
china.seasonal_climate: Continental climate (-4°C to 30°C). Spring (April - May) and Autumn (September - October) provide crisp skies and ideal sightseeing weather.

activities.name: Forbidden City & The Palace Museum (Beijing)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Forbidden City Hall of Supreme Harmony
activities.description: The world's largest palatial complex, home to 24 Ming and Qing emperors across 9,999 rooms with golden-glazed tile roofs and red citadel walls.
activities.reason: UNESCO World Heritage imperial palace at the ceremonial heart of China.

activities.name: Mutianyu Great Wall of China
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Mutianyu Great Wall of China
activities.description: Magnificently restored section of the 5,000-mile stone military barrier winding through pine-clad peaks, featuring 23 watchtowers and cable car access.
activities.reason: One of the Seven Wonders of the Medieval World and China's supreme monument.

activities.name: Temple of Heaven (Tiantan, Beijing)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Temple of Heaven Beijing
activities.description: Masterpiece of Ming ceremonial architecture where emperors performed winter solstice sacrifices for good harvests, centered on the Hall of Prayer.
activities.reason: Pinnacle of classical Chinese cosmologic wood construction without a single nail.

activities.name: West Lake (Hangzhou) Scenic Pavilions & Pagodas
activities.description: UNESCO-listed freshwater lake immortalized by Tang poets, surrounded by willow-lined causeways, Leifeng Pagoda, and green Longjing tea hills.
activities.reason: Archetypal classical Chinese landscape of poetic beauty.

vietnam.name: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Enchanting Southeast Asian kingdom of emerald limestone seas, lantern-lit ancient trading ports, French-colonial boulevards, and world-famous street gastronomy.
vietnam.seasonal_climate: Monsoon tropical climate (18°C - 33°C). October to April offers dry, pleasant conditions across both North and Central Vietnam.

activities.name: Ha Long Bay Emerald Waters & Limestone Karsts
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Ha Long Bay Vietnam
activities.description: UNESCO World Heritage natural wonder featuring 1,600 towering limestone pillars rising dramatically from the emerald waters of the Gulf of Tonkin.
activities.reason: One of the most spectacular seascape panoramas on planet Earth.

activities.name: Hoi An Ancient Town & Japanese Covered Bridge
activities.opening_hours: Open 24 hours (Night lantern market 06:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Hoi An Japanese Covered Bridge
activities.description: Exceptionally preserved 15th-century Southeast Asian trading port with French-colonial shophouses, Japanese wooden bridge, and silk lanterns.
activities.reason: Magical nocturnal atmosphere reflecting hundreds of silk lanterns over the Thu Bon River.

activities.name: Hoan Kiem Lake & Ngoc Son Temple (Hanoi)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Hoan Kiem Lake Turtle Tower Hanoi
activities.description: Legendary 'Lake of the Restored Sword' in downtown Hanoi with the scarlet Huc Bridge leading to an island temple honoring General Tran Hung Dao.
activities.reason: Spiritual focal point of Hanoi where locals practice morning tai chi under weeping willows.

activities.name: Temple of Literature (Van Mieu, Hanoi)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Temple of Literature Hanoi
activities.description: Founded in 1070 and dedicated to Confucius, Vietnam's first national university featuring stone stelae mounted on tortoises honoring royal scholars.
activities.reason: Serene walled sanctuary of Vietnamese scholarship, lotus ponds, and ancient bonsai.

maldives.name: Maldives
maldives.description: Tropical paradise archipelago of 1,200 coral atolls scattered across the Indian Ocean, famous for crystal-clear turquoise lagoons, manta rays, and overwater villas.
maldives.seasonal_climate: Tropical marine climate (26°C - 31°C). Dry season runs from November to April with calm turquoise seas.

activities.name: Hulhumale Public Beach & Coral Lagoon
activities.description: Pristine white powdery sand beach and shallow turquoise lagoon accessible via road from the international airport, lined with palm cafes.
activities.reason: Authentic public Maldivian beach experience offering water sports and calm bathing.

activities.name: Maafushi Island & Coral Reef Snorkeling
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Maafushi Island Coral Reefs
activities.description: Vibrant inhabited coral atoll island famous for accessible reef snorkeling with sea turtles, blacktip reef sharks, and sandbank excursions.
activities.reason: The capital of local island tourism in the Maldives with world-class snorkeling.

activities.name: Banana Reef Marine Protected Sanctuary
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Banana Reef Diving Sanctuary
activities.description: First officially designated marine protected area in the Maldives, shaped like a curved banana with dramatic overhangs, caves, and coral gardens.
activities.reason: World-class scuba diving spot teaming with moray eels, bannerfish, and reef sharks.

activities.name: Old Male Friday Mosque (Hukuru Miskiy) & Sultan Park
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Male Friday Mosque Hukuru Miskiy
activities.description: Constructed in 1658 from interlocking porous coral boulders carved with intricate Arabic calligraphy and lacquer woodwork.
activities.reason: UNESCO tentative list architectural monument representing ancient maritime coral craftsmanship.

bali.name: Bali
bali.description: The 'Island of the Gods', celebrated for dramatic clifftop sea temples, sculpted emerald rice terraces, sacred monkey forests, and traditional Balinese gamelan arts.
bali.seasonal_climate: Tropical climate (24°C - 31°C). Dry season (April - October) brings clear blue skies, lower humidity, and ocean breezes.

activities.name: Uluwatu Cliffside Temple & Sunset Kecak Fire Dance
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Uluwatu Temple Cliff Bali
activities.description: 11th-century Balinese sea temple perched precipitously atop a 70-meter sheer cliff plunging into the crashing waves of the Indian Ocean.
activities.reason: Unforgettable theatrical sunset spectacle overlooking the Indian Ocean abyss.

activities.name: Tegallalang Emerald Rice Terraces
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Tegallalang Rice Terraces Ubud
activities.description: Cascading emerald hillside terraces irrigated by the ancient 9th-century cooperative Subak communal water system.
activities.reason: UNESCO World Heritage cultural landscape and iconic photography setting.

activities.name: Tanah Lot Ancient Sea Temple
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Tanah Lot Sea Temple Bali
activities.description: 16th-century offshore rock shrine founded by sage Dang Hyang Nirartha, surrounded by crashing sea waves at high tide.
activities.reason: The most photographed sunset sea temple on the entire island of Bali.

activities.name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (Ubud)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Sacred Monkey Forest Ubud
activities.description: Enchanted rainforest nature reserve preserving 1,000 Balinese long-tailed macaques among moss-covered 14th-century temple ruins.
activities.reason: Living sanctuary manifesting the Tri Hita Karana philosophy of harmony with nature.

activities.name: Pura Besakih (Mother Temple of Bali)
activities.description: Grandest and holiest Hindu temple complex in Bali, perched 1,000 meters high on the volcanic slopes of Mount Agung with 23 separate shrines.
activities.reason: Most sacred temple sanctuary in Bali featuring towering multi-tiered meru pagodas.

activities.name: Tirta Empul Holy Water Spring Temple
activities.description: 10th-century national heritage water temple famous for sacred holy springs where pilgrims perform melukat purification rituals.
activities.reason: Authentic Balinese spiritual ritual experience amidst cool mountain spring pools.

activities.name: Seminyak Beach & Coastal Sunset Promenade
activities.description: Broad golden-sand coastline famous for ocean waves, colorful beanbag cafes, and Bali's most celebrated evening sunsets.
activities.reason: Relaxed beach atmosphere with live acoustic music and panoramic Indian Ocean sunset views.

activities.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Volcano Viewpoint
activities.description: Active volcano soaring 1,717 meters above sea level framing Lake Batur, famous for morning cloud-inversion sunrises.
activities.reason: Dramatic caldera dawn panorama across Bali's central highlands.

sydney.name: Sydney
sydney.description: Australia's dazzling harbor metropolis, framed by the white billowing sails of the Sydney Opera House, the Harbour Bridge, and world-famous golden surf at Bondi Beach.
sydney.seasonal_climate: Temperate maritime climate (12°C - 26°C). Sunny summers (December - February) and crisp pleasant winters (June - August).

activities.name: Sydney Opera House & Bennelong Point
activities.description: Jørn Utzon's 20th-century expressionist masterpiece with interlocking ceramic vaulted shells jutting into Sydney Harbour.
activities.reason: UNESCO World Heritage site recognized worldwide as Australia's ultimate architectural marvel.

activities.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge & Pylon Lookout
activities.opening_hours: Pedestrian walkway open 24 hours; Pylon 10:00 AM - 04:00 PM
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Sydney Harbour Bridge Circular Quay
activities.description: The 'Coathanger', a massive steel through arch bridge carrying trains, cars, and pedestrians 134 meters above the harbor.
activities.reason: Walking across offers sweeping bird's-eye views over Circular Quay and the Opera House.

activities.name: Bondi Beach & Bronte Coastal Cliffside Walk
activities.description: World-famous golden crescent surf beach and 6-kilometer clifftop walking path carved into sandstone cliffs overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
activities.reason: The quintessential Australian coastal lifestyle with famous ocean waves and Icebergs pool.

activities.name: Royal Botanic Garden Sydney & Mrs Macquarie's Chair
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
activities.description: 74-acre harborside oasis dating from 1816, leading to a historic 1810 sandstone rock ledge bench with iconic dual views of the Bridge and Opera House.
activities.reason: The single most famous postcard perspective of Sydney Harbour.

activities.name: Darling Harbour & Maritime Promenade
activities.description: Pedestrian waterside precinct housing Australian National Maritime Museum, SEA LIFE Aquarium, and waterfront restaurants.
activities.reason: Vibrant city precinct offering water views, pedestrian boardwalks, and evening dining.

activities.name: The Rocks Historic Quarter & Markets
activities.description: Oldest historic colonial neighborhood in Sydney with cobblestone laneways, 19th-century sandstone pubs, and artisan weekend markets.
activities.reason: Charming heritage atmosphere directly beneath the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

activities.name: Taronga Zoo & Harbour Skyline Viewpoint
activities.description: World-famous waterside zoological park home to over 4,000 animals including koalas, kangaroos, and sumatran tigers framing Sydney Harbour.
activities.reason: Iconic wildlife park with world's best giraffe enclosure vista framing Sydney skyline.

activities.name: Manly Beach & Scenic Harbour Ferry
activities.description: Cruising past Sydney Heads on the iconic green ferry to reach Norfolk pine-fringed ocean beaches and the Corso promenade.
activities.reason: Spectacular 30-minute harbor cruise combined with relaxed seaside dining and coastal walks.

melbourne.name: Melbourne
melbourne.description: Australia's cultural, sporting, and culinary capital, world-famed for Victorian laneways adorned with street art, artisanal specialty coffee, and the Great Ocean Road.
melbourne.seasonal_climate: Temperate oceanic climate (9°C - 26°C) famous for 'four seasons in one day'. Autumn (March - May) offers golden parklands.

activities.name: Federation Square & Ian Potter Centre
activities.description: Deconstructivist architectural plaza across Flinders Street Station housing the National Gallery of Victoria's dedicated Australian indigenous art collection.
activities.reason: The civic and creative beating heart of Melbourne on the Yarra River.

activities.name: Great Ocean Road & Twelve Apostles Day Tour
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Twelve Apostles Great Ocean Road
activities.description: Scenic coastal highway carved into cliffs by returning WWI soldiers, featuring colossal limestone stacks rising from the Southern Ocean.
activities.reason: One of the world's most spectacular coastal road trips easily accessed from Melbourne.

activities.name: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria
activities.description: 94-acre landscaped botanical haven with 8,500 plant species, ornamental lakes, and the Shrine of Remembrance monument.
activities.reason: Tranquil green sanctuary ranked among the finest inner-city botanical gardens globally.

spain.name: Spain
spain.description: Vibrant Iberian kingdom celebrated for Antoni Gaudí's Catalan modernism, the Moorish Alhambra fortress, world-class Prado art, and sun-kissed Mediterranean lifestyle.

local_emergency.hospital: Hospital Clinic Barcelona / La Paz Madrid

spain.seasonal_climate: Mediterranean continental climate (8°C - 31°C). Spring (April-June) and Autumn (September-October) offer ideal temperatures.

activities.name: Sagrada Família Basilica (Barcelona)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Sagrada Familia Barcelona Bernard Gagnon
activities.description: Antoni Gaudí's unfinished Catalan modernist masterpiece with tree-like organic columns and stained-glass lighting.
activities.reason: UNESCO World Heritage site and the most extraordinary basilica in Europe.

activities.name: Park Güell Architectural Terraces (Barcelona)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Park Guell Serpentine Bench
activities.description: Enchanted public garden system designed by Gaudí on Carmel Hill featuring mosaic salamanders and panoramic serpentine tiled benches.
activities.reason: Vibrant artistic park overlooking the Barcelona city grid and the Mediterranean.

activities.name: Royal Palace of Madrid (Palacio Real)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Royal Palace of Madrid
activities.description: Largest royal palace in Western Europe with 3,418 rooms, containing priceless Stradivarius instruments, Caravaggio paintings, and the Royal Armoury.
activities.reason: Opulent official residence of the Spanish monarchy with Sabatini gardens.

activities.name: Alhambra Palace & Generalife Gardens (Granada)
activities.description: 13th-century Nasrid Dynasty Moorish citadel with carved stucco arabesques, the Court of the Lions, and the fountains of the Generalife.
activities.reason: The pinnacle of Islamic palace architecture in Europe and Spain's most visited monument.

russia.name: Russia
russia.description: The world's largest nation, rich in tsarist palaces, orthodox golden domes, the Kremlin fortress in Moscow, and the imperial canals of St. Petersburg.
russia.seasonal_climate: Humid continental climate (-12°C to 25°C). Summer (June - August) brings pleasant warmth and the magical White Nights in St. Petersburg.

activities.name: Red Square & Saint Basil's Cathedral
activities.opening_hours: Red Square open 24 hours; Cathedral 10:00 AM - 06:00 PM
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Saint Basil's Cathedral Moscow
activities.description: Cobblestone heart of Moscow bordered by the Kremlin walls, GUM department store, and the flame-like multicolored onion domes of Saint Basil's Cathedral.
activities.reason: World-famous historical square and the architectural symbol of Russia.

activities.name: Moscow Kremlin Citadel & Armoury Chamber
activities.description: Historic fortified complex containing Cathedral Square with the Assumption Cathedral, Ivan the Great Bell Tower, and tsarist Faberge eggs in the Armoury.
activities.reason: Seat of Russian state power and treasure vault of tsarist imperial regalia.

activities.name: State Hermitage Museum & Winter Palace (St. Petersburg)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Winter Palace Hermitage St Petersburg
activities.description: Green-and-white Baroque Winter Palace on the Neva River, housing over three million masterpieces of art and antiquities founded by Catherine the Great.
activities.reason: Second largest art museum in the world and an imperial architectural wonder.

germany.name: Germany
germany.description: Heart of Central Europe, renowned for dramatic fairytale castles in the Bavarian Alps, monumental Gothic cathedrals along the Rhine, and the dynamic history of Berlin.
germany.seasonal_climate: Temperate seasonal climate (-1°C to 24°C). Summer (May - September) brings beer gardens and hiking; December brings magical Christmas markets.

activities.name: Brandenburg Gate (Berlin)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Brandenburg Gate Berlin Thomas Wolf
activities.description: 18th-century neoclassical triumphal arch crowned with the winged Quadriga chariot, symbol of German unity and European peace on Pariser Platz.
activities.reason: The defining national landmark of Germany and setting of modern world history.

activities.name: Reichstag Building & Norman Foster Glass Dome
activities.description: Historic German parliament building featuring Norman Foster's futuristic 360-degree helical glass cupola looking directly down into the debating chamber.
activities.reason: Fascinating blend of 19th-century history, eco-architecture, and Berlin skyline views.

activities.name: Cologne Cathedral (Kölner Dom)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Cologne Cathedral Kölner Dom
activities.description: High Gothic twin-spired Catholic cathedral taking over 600 years to complete, housing the gilded medieval Shrine of the Three Kings.
activities.reason: UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the largest Gothic cathedrals on Earth.

activities.name: Neuschwanstein Castle (Bavarian Alps)
activities.description: King Ludwig II's 19th-century Romanesque Revival fairy-tale palace crowning a rugged Alpine cliff above the Pöllat Gorge, inspiration for Disney's Sleeping Beauty castle.
activities.reason: The quintessential romantic European fairytale castle surrounded by pristine alpine peaks.

kerala.name: Kerala
kerala.description: God's Own Country: A curated state-wide circuit linking the mist-clad tea plantations of Munnar, colonial ports of Kochi, and tranquil backwater canals of Alappuzha.
kerala.seasonal_climate: Tropical monsoon climate (22°C - 33°C). Pleasant dry season from September to March.

activities.name: Chinese Fishing Nets & Fort Kochi Promenade
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Chinese Fishing Nets Kochi
activities.description: Cantilevered shore-operated fishing nets introduced by 14th-century Chinese traders, silhouetted against the Arabian Sea sunset.
activities.reason: Kochi's most iconic maritime sight and top photography destination.

activities.name: Punnamada Backwater Houseboat Cruise
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Kerala Backwater Houseboat Alappuzha
activities.description: Gliding on a traditional thatched kettuvallam through Vembanad Lake, paddy wetlands, and water-lily laden canals.
activities.reason: The quintessential Kerala backwaters experience with fresh regional Karimeen dining.

activities.name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
activities.description: Portuguese-built palace renovated by the Dutch, famed for exquisite Hindu murals depicting Ramayana and Mahabharata scenes.
activities.reason: Rare Renaissance-vernacular Kerala fusion palace housing ancient royal artifacts.

activities.name: Alappuzha Beach & Historic Pier Lighthouse
activities.opening_hours: Lighthouse: 03:00 PM - 05:00 PM; Beach: Open 24 Hours
activities.description: Wide sand beach with a 150-year-old railway sea pier extending into the Arabian Sea and a striped operational lighthouse.
activities.reason: Prime evening sunset walk and panoramic marine views from the lighthouse balcony.

karnataka.name: Karnataka
karnataka.description: One State, Many Worlds: Discover the grand royal palaces of Mysuru, the botanical gardens of Bengaluru, and the coffee-clad hills of the Western Ghats.
karnataka.seasonal_climate: Pleasant tropical plateau climate (18°C - 32°C). Best visited between September and March.

activities.name: Mysore Palace (Amba Vilas)
activities.opening_hours: 10:00 AM - 05:30 PM (Illuminated Sundays and Holidays 07:00 PM - 07:45 PM)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Mysore Palace Illuminated Amba Vilas
activities.description: Grand Indo-Saracenic royal residence of the Wadiyar dynasty featuring stained glass ceilings, carved mahogany pavilions, and 97,000 electric bulbs.
activities.reason: One of India's most visited royal monuments and an absolute architectural masterpiece.

activities.name: Chamundi Hill & Sri Chamundeshwari Temple
activities.description: Hilltop shrine consecrated to Goddess Chamundeshwari with a 1,000-step stone path and a colossal 16-foot monolithic Nandi bull carved in 1659.
activities.reason: Sacred hilltop protector shrine offering panoramic views across the Mysore cityscape.

activities.name: Brindavan Gardens & Musical Dancing Fountains
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Brindavan Gardens KRS Dam
activities.description: 60-acre terraced garden laid out below the Krishnarajasagara Dam, modeled after the Shalimar Gardens with synchronized musical fountains.
activities.reason: Iconic evening illuminated garden show famous across South India.

activities.name: St. Philomena's Neo-Gothic Cathedral
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / St Philomena's Cathedral Mysore
activities.description: Towering 175-foot twin-spired Neo-Gothic cathedral modeled after Germany's Cologne Cathedral, containing beautiful stained-glass windows.
activities.reason: One of the tallest churches in Asia and an astonishing architectural landmark.

tamil_nadu.name: Tamil Nadu
tamil_nadu.description: Land of ancient Dravidian gopurams, Marina coastal promenades in Chennai, serene French Quarter villas in Puducherry, and the cool eucalyptus peaks of the Nilgiris.
tamil_nadu.seasonal_climate: Tropical climate (22°C - 34°C). Pleasantly cool from October to March.

activities.name: Marina Beach & Coastal Promenade
activities.opening_hours: Open 24 hours (Best early morning or evening)
activities.description: 13-kilometer natural urban sandy beach along the Bay of Bengal featuring historical statues, lighthouse vantage, and evening food markets.
activities.reason: The premier social and cultural lifeline of Chennai.

activities.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple (Mylapore)
activities.opening_hours: 06:00 AM - 01:00 PM, 04:00 PM - 09:00 PM (Closed Mondays noon)
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Kapaleeshwarar Temple Gopuram Mylapore
