activities.description: 7th-century Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring an intricately sculpted 120-foot multicolored raja gopuram and sacred temple tank.
activities.reason: Quintessential Dravidian architectural splendor in historic Mylapore.

activities.name: Promenade Beach & French War Memorial
activities.opening_hours: Promenade pedestrian-only from 05:00 PM to 06:30 AM
activities.description: 1.5-kilometer scenic rock beach promenade lined with heritage statues, seaside cafes, and French colonial edifices.
activities.reason: Vibrant pedestrian seawalk capturing the romantic essence of Pondicherry.

activities.name: French Quarter (White Town) Heritage Walk
activities.opening_hours: Best explored early morning or late afternoon
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / White Town French Quarter Pondicherry
activities.description: Grid-planned French quarter featuring mustard-yellow colonial mansions, arched courtyards, wrought-iron balconies, and artisan boutiques.
activities.reason: Unrivalled Franco-Tamil architectural heritage with bohemian cafes and bakery aromas.

california.name: California
california.description: The Golden State: Experience the dramatic orange spans of San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge, the glacial majesty of Yosemite Valley, and the glamour of Los Angeles.
california.seasonal_climate: Mediterranean and alpine climates (10°C - 28°C). Sunshine year-round.

activities.name: Golden Gate Bridge & Vista Point
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Golden Gate Bridge Rich Niewiroski Jr.
activities.description: 1.7-mile international orange suspension bridge linking San Francisco to Marin Headlands across the Golden Gate strait.
activities.reason: One of the modern wonders of the world and the definitive visual icon of California.

activities.name: Yosemite Valley & El Capitan Meadow
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / El Capitan Yosemite Valley
activities.description: Sheer 3,000-foot vertical granite monolith rising directly from the Merced River floor, world-renowned as the ultimate rock-climbing wall.
activities.reason: Jaw-dropping geological wonder dominating the Yosemite Valley.

activities.name: Hollywood Sign & Griffith Park Trails
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Hollywood Sign Thomas Wolf
activities.description: Legendary 45-foot white lettering erected in 1923 atop Mount Lee in the Santa Monica Mountains overlooking the Los Angeles basin.
activities.reason: The universal cultural symbol of world cinema and Southern California glamour.

activities.name: Alcatraz Island & Historic Federal Penitentiary
activities.opening_hours: Ferry departures from Pier 33 08:40 AM - 04:00 PM
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Alcatraz Island D Ramey Logan
activities.description: Legendary offshore federal prison island in San Francisco Bay that once held Al Capone and Machine Gun Kelly, now a national park sanctuary.
activities.reason: Award-winning audio walkthrough of the historic cellhouse with panoramic bay skyline views.

activities.name: Santa Monica Pier & Pacific Coast Promenade
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Santa Monica Pier Sunset
activities.description: Century-old wooden pleasure pier marking the official end of historic Route 66, featuring the Pacific Wheel solar ferris wheel and golden sand beaches.
activities.reason: Iconic Southern California coastal sunset experience with Pacific ocean boardwalk vibes.

united_states.name: United States
united_states.description: From coast to coast: Experience New York's iconic Manhattan skyline and Central Park alongside California's Pacific coast and national parks.
united_states.seasonal_climate: Diverse continental climate. Spring and Autumn provide optimal nationwide travel conditions.

activities.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Statue of Liberty Ellis Island
activities.description: Colossal neoclassical copper sculpture on Liberty Island gifted by France in 1886, universal symbol of freedom alongside the Ellis Island Immigration Museum.
activities.reason: Global monument to hope and freedom with breathtaking New York Harbor views.

activities.name: Golden Gate Bridge & Vista Point
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Golden Gate Bridge Rich Niewiroski Jr.
activities.description: 1.7-mile international orange suspension bridge linking San Francisco to Marin Headlands across the Golden Gate strait.
activities.reason: One of the modern wonders of the world and the definitive visual icon of California.

activities.name: Central Park & Bethesda Terrace
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Central Park Mall New York
activities.description: 843-acre masterpiece of landscape architecture in the heart of Manhattan featuring Bow Bridge, Bethesda Fountain, the Mall, and Strawberry Fields.
activities.reason: The green lung of NYC offering tranquility amidst the soaring skyscraper canyons.

activities.name: Hollywood Sign & Griffith Park Trails
activities.photo_attribution: Wikimedia Commons / Hollywood Sign Thomas Wolf
activities.description: Legendary 45-foot white lettering erected in 1923 atop Mount Lee in the Santa Monica Mountains overlooking the Los Angeles basin.
activities.reason: The universal cultural symbol of world cinema and Southern California glamour.

activities.description: Sheer 3,000-foot vertical granite monolith rising directly from the Merced River floor, world-renowned as the ultimate rock-climbing wall.
activities.reason: Jaw-dropping geological wonder dominating the Yosemite Valley.

australia.name: Australia
australia.description: Experience the wonders of Australia, from Sydney's iconic harbour, Opera House and Bondi Beach to Melbourne's cultural arts laneways and the Great Ocean Road.
australia.seasonal_climate: Southern Hemisphere climate. Warm summer spans December to February; pleasant spring spans September to November.

activities.reason: Walking across offers sweeping bird's-eye views over Circular Quay and the Opera House.
